literal: When the emperor reached Jiangdu and retainers wavered in loyalty, a palace woman told the empress, "Outside one hears that everyone wishes to rebel."
idiomatic: When the emperor reached Jiangdu and retainers wavered in loyalty, a palace woman told the empress, "Outside one hears that everyone wishes to rebel."

literal: The empress said, "Report it as you will."
idiomatic: The empress said, "Report it as you will."

literal: The palace woman told the emperor; the emperor was furious and said, "That is not for you to say!"
idiomatic: The palace woman told the emperor; the emperor was furious and said, "That is not for you to say!"

literal: He had her beheaded.
idiomatic: He had her beheaded.

literal: Palace women again told the empress, "Among the night guards many whisper in pairs, plotting rebellion."
idiomatic: Palace women again told the empress, "Among the night guards many whisper in pairs, plotting rebellion."

literal: The empress said, "The realm's affairs have come in a day to this—power is gone and the form settled; nothing can save it.
idiomatic: The empress said, "The realm's affairs have come in a day to this—power is gone and the form settled; nothing can save it.

literal: What use in speaking?—you would only add worry and vexation to the emperor!"
idiomatic: What use in speaking?—you would only add worry and vexation to the emperor!"

literal: From then on none spoke again.
idiomatic: From then on none spoke again.

literal: At the turmoil of Yuwen Huaji, she followed the army to Liaocheng.
idiomatic: At the turmoil of Yuwen Huaji, she followed the army to Liaocheng.

literal: When Huaji was defeated, she fell into the hands of Dou Jiande.
idiomatic: When Huaji was defeated, she fell into the hands of Dou Jiande.

literal: Jiande's wife Lady Cao was jealous and fierce; Emperor Yang's consorts and palace beauties were all made to leave household life, and the empress was placed in Wuqiang county.
idiomatic: Jiande's wife Lady Cao was jealous and fierce; Emperor Yang's consorts and palace beauties were all made to leave household life, and the empress was placed in Wuqiang county.

literal: At that time the Tujue khan Chuluo was at his height; his great empress was none other than the Sui Princess of Yicheng, who sent envoys to receive the empress.
idiomatic: At that time the Tujue khan Chuluo was at his height; his great empress was none other than the Sui Princess of Yicheng, who sent envoys to receive the empress.

literal: Jiande dared not detain her; he then led his grandson Zhengdao and all his daughters into the barbarians' court.
idiomatic: Jiande dared not detain her; he then led his grandson Zhengdao and all his daughters into the barbarians' court.

literal: In the fourth year of Zhenguan of Great Tang, the Turks were broken and all were brought in by ceremony.
idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhenguan of Great Tang, the Turks were broken and all were brought in by ceremony.

literal: She returned to the capital and was given a residence in Xingdao Lane.
idiomatic: She returned to the capital and was given a residence in Xingdao Lane.

literal: In the twenty-first year she died.
idiomatic: In the twenty-first year she died.

literal: An edict buried her with empress rites at Yangzhou, interred with Emperor Yang's tomb, posthumous title Min.
idiomatic: An edict buried her with empress rites at Yangzhou, interred with Emperor Yang's tomb, posthumous title Min.

literal: Appraisal says: Correct position of man and woman is the great bond of human relations.
idiomatic: Appraisal says: Correct position of man and woman is the great bond of human relations.

literal: From the Three Dynasties onward down to Han and Jin—when was there not ruin through favor and jealousy, and rise through sage and worthy women?
idiomatic: From the Three Dynasties onward down to Han and Jin—when was there not ruin through favor and jealousy, and rise through sage and worthy women?

literal: As when Houji received spirit from a giant footprint and Shendu was born of a heavenly maid—the line flourished from afar, different ages, one sign.
idiomatic: As when Houji received spirit from a giant footprint and Shendu was born of a heavenly maid—the line flourished from afar, different ages, one sign.

literal: The Wei empresses' women's foresight—none worth discussing.
idiomatic: The Wei empresses' women's foresight—none worth discussing.

literal: Empress Wenming was perverse and dangerous—by good fortune the state did not fall.
idiomatic: Empress Wenming was perverse and dangerous—by good fortune the state did not fall.

literal: Empress Ling was licentious and willful—at last she lost the realm.
idiomatic: Empress Ling was licentious and willful—at last she lost the realm.

literal: The caution of a woman who overturns states—is it not here?
idiomatic: The caution of a woman who overturns states—is it not here?

literal: Empress Yi driven by terror and force—there was hurt enough indeed.
idiomatic: Empress Yi driven by terror and force—there was hurt enough indeed.

literal: In old times, when Gouyi was young and her son still a child, Han Wu for this reason acted drastically; Wei age made it routine usage—the mother must die when the son is exalted.
idiomatic: In old times, when Gouyi was young and her son still a child, Han Wu for this reason acted drastically; Wei age made it routine usage—the mother must die when the son is exalted.

literal: The righting of excess—does it not go too far!
idiomatic: The righting of excess—does it not go too far!

literal: Emperor Xiaowen at last reformed that fault—he had good cause.
idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowen at last reformed that fault—he had good cause.

literal: Shenwu first raised Qi enterprise; Wuming followed Zhou's turmoil in her track.
idiomatic: Shenwu first raised Qi enterprise; Wuming followed Zhou's turmoil in her track.

literal: Lord Wen's ruin of state and house—Consort Feng walked the trail of Bao.
idiomatic: Lord Wen's ruin of state and house—Consort Feng walked the trail of Bao.

literal: Thus whether defilement or ascent has meaning—in the main it is bound together.
idiomatic: Thus whether defilement or ascent has meaning—in the main it is bound together.

literal: The rest who made calamity and scourge—outwardly calm, inwardly wasted—in recent times it was severest in Qi.
idiomatic: The rest who made calamity and scourge—outwardly calm, inwardly wasted—in recent times it was severest in Qi.

literal: Zhou lineage from Emperor Wen down to Emperor Wu—years over two reigns, the age passed four lords.
idiomatic: Zhou lineage from Emperor Wen down to Emperor Wu—years over two reigns, the age passed four lords.

literal: Enterprise was not the time of founding by the knife; affairs differed from days of expedient measure.
idiomatic: Enterprise was not the time of founding by the knife; affairs differed from days of expedient measure.

literal: Yet they cast aside kin and took alien ways, using barbarians to disorder the Chinese.
idiomatic: Yet they cast aside kin and took alien ways, using barbarians to disorder the Chinese.

literal: They fouled the ritual order of marriage and sought gain beyond the wolf's pack.
idiomatic: They fouled the ritual order of marriage and sought gain beyond the wolf's pack.

literal: Soon the requited grew weary; the granters knew no satiety.
idiomatic: Soon the requited grew weary; the granters knew no satiety.

literal: What had been called harmony marriage—in no time it had become foe.
idiomatic: What had been called harmony marriage—in no time it had become foe.

literal: The way of orthodox and unorthodox differs from this.
idiomatic: The way of orthodox and unorthodox differs from this.

literal: At that time Emperor Wu, though controlled by others and not himself attending to ordinary government, yet to have planners hoarding stratagems while straight ministers had their mouths clamped—excess indeed!
idiomatic: At that time Emperor Wu, though controlled by others and not himself attending to ordinary government, yet to have planners hoarding stratagems while straight ministers had their mouths clamped—excess indeed!

literal: Yet reading through former records, kin by marriage holding the seat of chief minister are many;
idiomatic: Yet reading through former records, kin by marriage holding the seat of chief minister are many;

literal: but those who overturned Han's house were the Wang clan, those who doomed Zhou's house were the Yang—why do the woes of perishing match as if by tally?
idiomatic: but those who overturned Han's house were the Wang clan, those who doomed Zhou's house were the Yang—why do the woes of perishing match as if by tally?

literal: Emperor Wen took warning from afar and greatly reformed earlier faults, so empress families did not meet disaster's cause.
idiomatic: Emperor Wen took warning from afar and greatly reformed earlier faults, so empress families did not meet disaster's cause.

literal: Dugu held power but not like Lü and Huo—preserved intact before Renshou;
idiomatic: Dugu held power but not like Lü and Huo—preserved intact before Renshou;

literal: Xiao's power unlike Liang and Dou—did not topple the great enterprise afterward.
idiomatic: Xiao's power unlike Liang and Dou—did not topple the great enterprise afterward.

literal: Some did not fall from the old foundation, some even further exalted what was firmly built—is it not because they were placed by the Way that this came about?
idiomatic: Some did not fall from the old foundation, some even further exalted what was firmly built—is it not because they were placed by the Way that this came about?
